item.title: Bulletin updated at 13:10 HKT 16/Jun/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The heavy showers and thunderstorms associated with the active southwest monsoon will move into the inland areas of southern China gradually tomorrow. With an anticyclone aloft strengthening gradually, the weather will improve and it will be very hot over the coastal areas of southern China in the next few days. However, under the influence of a southerly airstream, there will still be a few showers over the region.
